observations.evidence: Verified anchors against sketch pixels: roof peak sits left of center (~23% of panel width vs ~28% in sketch) with the longer right slope and chimney on the right slope; door on the left wall and round window on the right wall as drawn. Tree crown is a narrow tall oval right of the house (crown ~29% of panel width, closest of all candidates to the sketch's ~25%), trunk widens to the ground. Moon is a small disc at ~78% x / 17% y matching the sketch circle. Upper-left sky left open with only cloud wash. Counts exact: one cottage, one tree, one moon; only grass texture added. Rendered entirely in monochrome ink-wash; watercolor storybook mood is present but no color, so spell fidelity slightly reduced.

Mug trapezoid (wide top, narrow base, oval rim) at lower-left center matches the sketch footprint (~34% x center vs ~39% in sketch, top ~46% y, base ~78% y). Steam wisp present above the mug. Two books upper right with the upper book standing upright on a flat lower book, matching the sketch's tall parallelogram over flatter shape. DEVIATION: the sketch's angular handle on the right side of the mug with an empty central hole is entirely absent; the mug is a handleless cup. Books are enlarged and run off the right crop (sketch books end at ~95% width). Leaf-shadow window light and wooden table are supported atmosphere.

Head at upper left with two horns, single eye dot, and diagonal beak/mouth line exactly as sketched; bent neck descends to a large horizontal oval body (~46% panel width vs 44% in sketch). Single kite-shaped folded wing above middle-right of body with top-left corner at ~44% x / 31% y (sketch ~48% / 32%). Tail exits body right, dips, then bends upward to a tip at ~91% x / 42% y (sketch ~94% / 43%). Two legs below body, both feet pointing right like the sketch's L-shaped feet. Clay texture with spots is finish inside the forms; cream background retained. Body slightly rounder than the sketch oval.

Asymmetric roof with peak left of center and chimney on the longer right slope matches; door left, round lit window right on the house body; moon small at upper right ~78% x. Tree stands right of house with trunk reaching the ground and crown top at ~y 27% like the sketch. Crown is rounder and broader (~39% of panel width vs ~25% in sketch). Unsupported subordinate additions: distant treeline/hills behind the tree, bushes flanking the house, small rocks. Upper-left sky remains open. Full color watercolor storybook treatment.

Mug placed at the sketch's lower-left position with matching trapezoid taper and oval rim. DEVIATIONS: handle absent (sketch shows an angular loop with an empty hole on the mug's right); the steam line is only a barely perceptible wisp above the rim; both books are rendered as thick brick-like blocks stacked flat rather than the sketch's tall thin upper book over a flatter lower one, and both run off the right crop. Window-bar shadows and wooden table are supported atmosphere.

Control case; result is a replacement picture. Sketch has one cottage at lower left, one tree right of it, one small moon upper right, and open upper-left sky. Result places a large castle centered on a hill, a snow mountain filling the upper left, a river across the foreground with a stone bridge, two moons in the sky, a cottage relocated to the lower right, and a tree at the far right edge. Cottage roof asymmetry and door/window layout are not preserved. Beautifully finished watercolor but nothing registers with the sketch; severe geometry failure, capped at 50.

summary: All 22 comparison images were read and inspected; no results were missing. Weighted totals per case (0-100): cottage P01 91.5, P02 90, P03 92, P04 94.5, P05 87, P06 90, P07 94.5, P08 25 (capped 50 but severe); cup-books P01 77, P02 72.5, P03 73, P04 80, P05 80, P06 80, P07 80; dragon P01 97.5, P02 97.5, P03 94, P04 97.5, P05 97.5, P06 97.5, P07 95. Candidate sums: P04 272, P07 269.5, P06 267.5, P01 266, P05 264.5, P02 260, P03 259. P08 is the misleading control: its prompt tells the model to ignore the sketch and the output confirms it (castle, mountain, river, two moons), so it is the only severe geometry failure. Key systematic finding: every one of the seven cup-books outputs omits the mug handle that the sketch clearly draws as an angular loop with an empty hole on the mug's right side; this is a component omission rather than a missing major subject, so I did not flag it as severe, but if the tournament treats the handle as a major form all seven cup-books rows should be capped at 50 and the ranking is unchanged since the omission is uniform. Cup-books therefore discriminates mainly on book shape (P02 and P03 rendered flat brick stacks that run off the crop; P04-P07 rendered the sketch's standing-upper-book reading inside the frame) and steam visibility (P02 nearly invisible). Cottage discriminates on tree-crown proportion (P01, P04, P07 kept the narrow oval; P02, P03, P05, P06 broadened it) and on unsupported additions (P05 and P06 added smoke, stars, hills, paths). Dragon outputs are near-identical across candidates; only P03's reversed left foot and P07's raised body and wing separate them. Uncertainties: pixel coordinate estimates are visual approximations from the downscaled comparison panels, so differences under roughly 5% of panel width should be treated as ties; P01 and P03 monochrome renderings were judged as slightly weaker spell matches for color-implying spells, which is a judgment call. The separation between P04, P07, P06, and P01 is within a few points and would need repeats to confirm.
